SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. H:..........
Shanghai, January 26, 1929.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Political

（批：Col. Hsiao... known... of new... a rumour...）

As a result of rumours that communists would create trouble in Woosung and in Chinese controlled territory in the western district of Shanghai on January 25, special precautions were taken by the authorities concerned but nothing untoward occurred.

M. J. Avenol, Assistant Secretary General of the League of Nations, arrived in Shanghai on January 25, in the s.s. "Empress of Asia". He was met by Mr. S.K.Chen from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and a representative of the French Consul-General.

The Disbandment and Reorganization Conference closed on January 25. A Committee to deal with the decisions of the Conference will be formed and inaugurated on February 2.

General Hsiung Shih Hwei, local Defence Commissioner, has forwarded to Nanking a telegram denouncing General Chang Chi-kiang, Chairman of the Anti-Opium Committee, for having shielded Col. Tai Shih-fu in the recent opium scandal and requesting that an investigation be made into the matter.

At the instance of the Chinese Authorities, the Municipal Police arrested on January 24 at Bah Tung Lodging House, 299 Hankow Road, six Chinese wanted in connexion with communistic uprising which recently occurred in the neighbourhood of Kiangyin. The prisoners appeared before the Provisional Court on January 25, and were remanded pending the arrival from Kiangyin the necessary evidence against them;

Small whitepaper slips bearing the following inscriptions were thrown from the Sincere Co.'s Roof Garden at 5.30 p.m. January 25, 1929:-

上海，1929年1月26日。

情报报告。
政治类

（批注：萧上校……已知……新的……谣言……）

鉴于有谣言称共产党人将于1月25日在吴淞及上海西区华界制造事端，有关当局采取了特别预防措施，但未发生任何意外事件。

国际联盟副秘书长阿韦诺尔（M. J. Avenol）于1月25日乘“亚细亚皇后”号轮船抵达上海。外交部陈绍宽先生及法国总领事代表前往迎接。

裁兵整理会议于1月25日闭幕。一个负责处理会议决议的委员会将于2月2日成立并启动。

当地防卫委员熊式辉将军已向南京发送电报，谴责禁烟委员会主席张继江将军在最近的鸦片丑闻中包庇戴世福上校，并要求对此事进行调查。

应中国当局要求，公共租界警务处于1月24日在汉口路299号巴东旅馆逮捕了六名与近期发生在江阴附近的共产主义暴动有关的被通缉华人。囚犯于1月25日出庭受审于临时法院，并被还押候审，等待从江阴送达针对他们的必要证据；

C. I. D.

Shanghai, January 26, 1929.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Labour

The dispute in the Nanyang Bros. Tobacco Co. Postung
Factory has not yet been settled.
About half of the workers have left the factory for their
respective homes and now only 1,500 hands including about 800
females are turning up each day.
The distribution of the annual bonus did not take place
yesterday, January 25, but it is expected that it will be
continued when those workers who returned to their homes come
to get it.

The strike situation in the Sun Sun Co., No.145 Nanking
Road, remains unchanged. Some 30 members of the Strike Committee
held a meeting between 5 and 6.40 p.m. January 25, 1929, in the
( illegible )
offices of their union at No.7 Kung Yih Li (North Thibet Road)and
passed the following resolutions:-
1. That the strength of strike pickets be increased from 20 to 30.
2. That the strike pickets endeavour to locate and arrest labour
traitors and running dogs.
3. That the employees be not permitted to work for the Company
until the dispute has been satisfactorily settled.
4. That a further meeting be held at 2 p.m. January 26, 1929, at
the same place.

上海，1929年1月26日。

情报报告。
劳工

南洋兄弟烟草公司浦东工厂的纠纷尚未解决。
约有一半工人已离厂返回各自家中，目前每天仅有1,500名工人出勤，其中包括约800名女工。
年终奖金并未于昨日（1月25日）发放，但预计待返乡工人回来领取时将继续发放。

南京路145号新新公司的罢工局势保持不变。1929年1月25日下午5时至6时40分之间，约30名罢工委员会成员在（原文不清）工会办事处（位于北西藏路公义里7号）举行会议，并通过以下决议：-
1. 将罢工纠察队人数从20人增加至30人。
2. 罢工纠察队应尽力 locate 并逮捕工贼及走狗。
3. 在纠纷得到满意解决之前，不得允许雇员为公司工作。
4. 于1929年1月26日下午2时在同一地点再次举行会议。

TRANSLATION OF EXTRACTS FROM FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE REPORTS.

January 26, 1929.

The sixth and last session of the conference on the disbandment of troops was held at 1 p.m. yesterday at which it was resolved to disband 800,000 troops and to establish supervisory committees.

General Hsiung Shih Hwei, Garrison Commissioner of Woosung and Shanghai, having suggested the construction of barracks at Nantao, Chapei, Woosung etc., and the Nanking Government having raised no opposition, the Ministry of Finance will provide a sum of $2,700,000 for the expenses of the construction. We learn that work will commence in April.

The communistic troops of Chu Te, after their defeat in Kiangsi Province by the regular troops of that province and of Hunan, have abandoned their headquarters at Tsing Kang Chang and have established themselves at Kengchoufu, Tayuhsien, etc. on the border of Kwangtung Province. Their headquarters is now at Shaohai, Kwangtung Province.

The soldiers of the Third Division under the command of General Lu Hai Hai, a unit of the 6th Section of the Nationalist troops under General Li Chi Song, President of the Political Committee of Canton, stationed at Shaohai, have discovered a number of communistic offices in this city. They have arrested 50 persons who have confessed to being under the orders of Chu Te and to having been sent to the city to prepare a communistic rising.

A party of soldiers of the 6th Company of the 2nd Battalion of the 19th Regiment of the Third Division stationed at Fengching have been transferred to Sungkiang. They have been replaced by a company of machine gunners of the 2nd Regiment of the bodyguards of the Chekiang Provincial Government.

40 soldiers of the sappers corps of the Fifth Division under the command of the Garrison Commissioner of Woosung and Shanghai, who had been sent to Jessfield to be employed on the construction of Chung San Road, returned to Lunghua at 9 a.m. yesterday.

January 28.

General Chiang Kai Shek arrived at Shanghai at 7.15 a.m. yesterday from Nanking. He is staying at No. 130 Seymour Road.
At 10.10 a.m. he visited Admiral Yang Su Chang, Commander-in-Chief of the Nationalist Fleet, at No. 874 Avenue Joffre.
At 11.15 a.m. he proceeded to his office at No. 311 Rue Tenant de la Tour.
At 12.10 p.m. he called on Tan Yen Kai, Chairman of the Legislative Council, at No. 37 Tongshan Road.
At 12.30 p.m. he returned to 130 Seymour Road
At 2 p.m. he proceeded to Koechangmiao to attend the launching of the warship Ning Hai.
At 3.45 p.m. he proceeded to No. 9 Rue Francis Garnier.
At 4 p.m. he visited Madame Ho Shiang Hie at No. 6 Rue Lafayette, Lafayette Terrace.
At 4.30 p.m. he called on Yu Yu Jen, a Councillor to the Nationalist Government, No. 615 Rue Rue Lee, Gordon Road.
At 7 p.m. he visited Wang Shih Wei, Minister of Labour and Commerce, at No. 388 Route Petchili.
At 8 p.m. he dined at the Russian restaurant at No. 1240 Rue Lafayette.
At 9 p.m. he returned to 130 Seymour Road where he spent the night.

The following persons called on Chiang Kai Shek:-
Mr. T. V. Soong, Director of the Central Bank.
Dr. C. T. Wang, the former Minister for Foreign Affairs.

法国警察情报报告摘录译文。

1929年1月26日。

昨日下午1时举行了裁兵会议的第六次暨最后一次会议，会上决定裁撤80万军队并设立监督委员会。

吴淞及上海卫戍司令熊式辉将军建议在南市、闸北、吴淞等地修建营房，南京政府未表示反对，财政部将提供270万元用于建设费用。据悉，工程将于四月开始。

朱德的共产党部队在江西省被该省及湖南省的正规军击败后，已放弃其在青江张（音译）的总部，并在广东省边境的赣州府、大庾县等地立足。其总部现位于广东省少海（音译）。

驻防少海的国民党军第六路军（广州政治委员会主席李济深将军麾下）第三师陆海海（音译）将军部下的士兵，在该市发现多处共产党机关。他们逮捕了50人，这些人供认受朱德指挥，并被派往该市准备共产主义暴动。

驻防枫泾的第三师第十九团第二营第六连的一部分士兵已调往松江。他们由浙江省政府警卫团第二团的一个机枪连接替。

吴淞及上海卫戍司令指挥下的第五师工兵营40名士兵，此前被派往极司菲尔路从事中山路的建设工作，于昨日上午9时返回龙华。

1月28日。

蒋介石将军于昨日上午7时15分从南京抵达上海。他住在西摩路130号。
上午10时10分，他在霞飞路874号拜访了国民党海军总司令杨树庄上将。
上午11时15分，他前往杜美路311号的办公室。
中午12时10分，他在同山路37号拜访了立法院院长谭延闿。
中午12时30分，他返回西摩路130号。
下午2时，他前往高昌庙参加“宁海”号军舰的下水仪式。
下午3时45分，他前往弗朗西斯·加尼尔路9号。
下午4时，他在拉斐特露台拉斐特路6号拜访了何香凝女士。
下午4时30分，他在戈登路李路615号拜访了国民政府委员于右任。
晚上7时，他在北直隶路388号拜访了工商部长王世伟（音译）。
晚上8时，他在拉斐特路1240号的俄罗斯餐厅用餐。
晚上9时，他返回西摩路130号并在此过夜。

下列人员拜访了蒋介石：-
中央银行行长宋子文先生。
前外交部长王正廷博士。

pages.en:
At 9 p.m. Dr Chih Hui, Councillor to the Nationalist
Government, and Li Shih Tseng, member of the Peking Political
Commission.
At 9.30 p.m. General Hsiung Shih Hwei, Garrison Commissioner
of Tientsin and Tangku.
At 10.30 p.m. General Chang Fah Kwei, ex-Commander of
the Fourth Army.

The Burmese residents in Shanghai have formed a
committee for the revision of the Sino-French Commercial
Treaty with an office at No. 1 Wan Yuen Lee, Foochow Road.
Chang Iao Chen is the chairman.

Dissatisfied at the decisions reached by the conference
on the disbandment of soldiers, General Pei Chung Hai has
telegraphed his resignation to the Nanking Government from the
position of Commander-in-Chief of the North-East sector of the
Fourth Group Nationalist Armies.

About 2,000 workers of the Pestung Factory of the B.A.T.
have been on strike since January 26 as a protest against the
dismissal of a worker named Hsu Yang Teh. Yesterday delegates
were sent to request the management to reinstate the dismissed
worker, but this was refused. A petition referring to this
matter was sent to the Social Affairs Bureau by the Union of
B.A.T. Workers yesterday.
It is believed that a general strike (general strike of
B.A.T. workers) is about to be declared.

The Postal Workers Union of Shanghai, which has 2,000
members, whose office is on the third floor of the Central Post
Office on North Szechuen Road, has published a declaration against
the Ministry of Communications for having ordered the removal of
the office of the Union to some other place. A copy of the
declaration is in our hands.

The Labour Unions of the Nos. 3 and 4 Mills of the Naiga
Wata Kaisha on Ichang Road, in the western district of Shanghai,
have been reorganised. The inauguration ceremony took place
on January 27.

Yesterday the following communistic circulars were distributed
around at Siao So Doe by members of the Kiangsu Communist Party:
"Support the Soviets," "Observe the principles of Lenin," "Support
the Communistic Youths," "Down with the running dogs of the
imperialists," "Overthrow the wicked personages, the capitalists
and the militarists," "Establish Soviet Power." etc.

Chang Chung Chang has moved into Shantung. The Chihli-
Shantung troops under the command of Liu Kai Tai at Lungkow and
those of Liu Cheng Hsien to the east of Kiaochow, who had gone
over to the National Government, have returned to Chang Chung Chang.
Yesterday the two Generals commanding these troops put to death all
the officials of the National Government and seized the reins of
power. At Wehsien, Shantung Province, 1000 soldiers under Chu
Jan Guo, a follower of Chang Chung Chang, are fighting against
the Nationalist troops beneath the walls of the city. This
decisive move by Chang Chung Chang, at the instigation of the
Japanese, will serve as a pretext to the Japanese not to withdraw
their soldiers from Shantung.

At 8.50 p.m. January 28, 30 bandits raided the Second Branch
of the Chinese Police at Nanhaw and carried off 20 rifles.

JAN 29 1929
pages.zh:
晚上9时，国民政府委员褚慧（音译）及北平政治委员会成员李石曾。

晚上9时30分，天津及塘沽卫戍司令熊式辉将军。

晚上10时30分，前第四军军长张发奎将军。

在上海的缅甸居民已成立一个修订《中法商约》委员会，办事处设在福州路万源利1号。张耀臣（音译）任主席。

裴中海（音译）将军对裁兵会议所达成的决定表示不满，已从第四集团军东北方面军总指挥一职向南京政府致电辞职。

自1月26日以来，英美烟草公司（B.A.T.）浦东工厂约2000名工人举行罢工，以抗议开除一名名为徐阳德（音译）的工人。昨日派出代表要求资方复职被开除工人，但遭拒绝。英美烟草公司工会昨日就此事向社会局递交了一份请愿书。

据悉，即将宣布总罢工（英美烟草公司工人总罢工）。

拥有2000名会员的上海邮务工会，其办事处位于北四川路中央邮局三楼，已发表宣言，反对交通部命令将该工会办事处迁往他处。该宣言副本已在吾人手中。

位于上海西区宜昌路的内外棉株式会社第三、第四纱厂工会已完成改组。就职典礼于1月27日举行。

昨日，江苏共产党成员在小沙渡（Siao So Doe）一带散发了下列共产主义传单：“拥护苏维埃”、“遵守列宁主义原则”、“支持共产主义青年团”、“打倒帝国主义走狗”、“推翻奸人、资本家及军阀”、“建立苏维埃政权”等。

张宗昌已移驻山东。原已归顺国民政府的、由刘开泰（音译）指挥的龙口直鲁部队，以及位于胶州以东的刘珍年（音译）部队，均已重新归附张宗昌。昨日，指挥这些部队的两位将军处决了国民政府的所有官员，并夺取了权力。在山东省潍县，张宗昌的追随者朱然国（音译）麾下的1000名士兵正在城下与国民革命军作战。张宗昌在日本唆使下采取的这一决定性举动，将为日本不撤出其在山东的军队提供借口。

1月28日晚上8时50分，30名匪徒袭击了南汇中国警察第二分局，抢走步枪20支。

1929年1月29日
